titulo_es: A nuanced conclusion · Thesis, evidence and counterargument

texto: It locates the thesis, the reasons and the evidence. A counterargument can be partially granted and then limited; «dog», «imidlertid» and «alligevel» guide that relationship.
Compare the two tracks and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
